prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1277; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents our client in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client was injured in the incident, and we request that all future communication regarding this matter be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or any other means.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, please provide a certified copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the at-fault driver. We also ask that you confirm in writing the coverage position taken on this loss.

Please preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, repair estimates, telematics or vehicle data, dash camera footage, and any third-party reports. Destruction or alteration of such material may result in serious consequences for your company, and we expect full cooperation in keeping it intact while the matter is pending.
